description: For a regulation id, find compliance Controls that may satisfy it, each with a priority signal (`blocker` (readers see it as "Before launch") / `required` (readers see it as "Once live") / `evaluate` (readers see it as "Depends on your product") / `best-practice` (readers see it as "Good practice")) and a short summary of the work. Returns research information about typical control mappings, not a determination that a given product needs them. Consult counsel for scoping.
name: find_controls
title: Find compliance controls
